architect.description: Writes the technical spec, data-model.md when the data model changes, and the ordered task list from a reviewed PRD. Use for engineering handoff.
architect.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Write, Bash(git *), Bash(ls *), Bash(find *)

test-writer.description: Writes failing tests for one task from tasks.md, using the repo's existing test conventions. Edits test files only.
test-writer.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Write, Edit, Bash

retro.description: After a feature ships, reads its review-log, qa-report, and agent-runs.log and proposes edits to rules, agents, and CLAUDE.md so the same mistakes are not repeated. Proposes; the user applies.

requirements-analyst.description: Checks a PRD against the real codebase for feasibility, conflicts, gaps, and reuse. Use after a PRD exists and before any design or code.
requirements-analyst.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash(git *), Bash(ls *), Bash(find *), Bash(wc *)

qa-engineer.description: Writes and runs acceptance tests per PRD requirement on an approved branch, black-box where possible. Use after code review approves.
qa-engineer.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Write, Edit, Bash

implementer.description: Implements one task from tasks.md to make its failing tests pass, or fixes blocker/major findings from a review round. Edits source files only; test files and CI/lint config are read-only (hook enforced).
implementer.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Write, Edit, Bash

product-manager.description: Turns an idea into a PRD with numbered, testable requirements. Use at the start of a feature or when requirements are vague.
product-manager.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Write, Bash(git log *), Bash(git ls-files *)

code-reviewer.description: Independent review of a feature branch against its PRD and spec. Reads the diff, runs the tests itself, checks requirement coverage and security, and issues a VERDICT. Never reads the implementer's notes. Use after implementation and after each fix round.

estimator.description: Estimates real effort and the worst case for a ticket from the code it touches and past features in the repo. Adds no scope; unknowns become questions with their cost. Use any time after ticket.md exists; rerun after grill or handoff.
estimator.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Write, Bash(git *), Bash(ls *), Bash(find *), Bash(wc *)
